title: Standing grant: a lane opens its own draft PR
why: Owner 17:10 CST Nov 12, after lane cloud-hooks-stale-copy stopped to ask before opening its draft PR: "yes open the draft PR ... but kinda a problem no". The cloud default says no PR unless the user asks, and claude-settings .claude/CLAUDE.md has no grant line, so a lane that reads it literally stalls.
note: Settled, no owner item: decision draft-until-reviewed (owner 2026-10-10 and 2026-10-13) already rules that every PR opens as a draft and lane PRs stay drafts; only the integration PR goes ready. Land it as a Standing grants line in .claude/CLAUDE.md citing that decision: any lane that a coordinator or lane started may open its own draft PR and never marks it ready. Degen carries the same grant (its item 161 a). Owner 17:10 CST yes covers cloud-hooks-stale-copy's PR now.
